description: This file defines the ParserException class, which extends RuntimeException and implements interfaces related to monitoring events and response containers within the AWS SDK for PHP. It encapsulates error details such as error code, request ID, and HTTP response, and is used to handle exceptions occurring during API parsing.

classes.name: ParserException
classes.description: Custom exception class for parsing errors in AWS SDK PHP, providing access to error code, request ID, and HTTP response details.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of ParserException with message, code, previous exception, and contextual information such as error code, request ID, and response.

methods.name: getErrorCode
methods.description: Returns the error code associated with the exception, if any.

methods.name: getRequestId
methods.description: Returns the request ID associated with the error, if available.

methods.name: getResponse
methods.description: Returns the HTTP response object associated with the error, if available.
